Palamu darshan- Palamu Darshan | navratri vishesh bhakti git | gayika chandni sinh ki madhur prastuti | DD JHARKHAND
Navratri ke pavan avsar par dekhie durdarshan jharkhand ka vishesh karyakram ‘palamu darshan’, jismen suprasiddh gayika chandni sinh ne apni madhur aavaz men man durga ko samarpit bhaktimay giton ki manmohak prastuti di hai. man durga ki aaradhna, shakti, bhakti aur aastha se saje in giton ke madhyam se anubhav kijie navratri ka pavan ullas aur bhaktimay vatavarna.
